assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent dizziness, raising concern for symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these episodic symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The service is in support of diagnoses I48.91, I34.0, and I49.5.
